ai_summary: Aksharchem (India) Limited reported a challenging FY 2025-26, incurring a net loss of ₹43.86 lakhs and a 2.16% EBITDA decline, primarily due to rising input costs, geopolitical headwinds, and US tariffs, despite a 7.5% increase in total income. The company responded by strategically investing in long-term resilience, including a 50% expansion of Precipitated Silica capacity to 18,000 MTPA and a 7.93 MWp solar power installation, positioning itself for future growth in specialty chemicals despite the current profitability setback.
